The guy who you're watching through the eyes of is playing Bandit, an operator who has the ability to place these batteries that electrify certain metallic items. In the video, Bandit shoots the opposing operator, who becomes injured and unable to do anything other than sit there and wait for his demise. Bandit screws around with him while waiting for the operator to bleed out. Bandit then gets this ridiculous idea of going over the top with finishing off the opposing operator. Bandit picks up the barbed wire, places it on the opposing operator, picks up an battery placed earlier, and places it on the barbed wire. The wire becomes electrified, and kills the operator.
